column1: Whisk the flour, baking soda, cream of tartar, and salt in a medium bowl.
Beat the butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar about 3 minutes until creamy.
Beat in the egg, then the peanut butter and vanilla.
Mix in the dry ingredients on low, then add the chopped peanuts.
Cover and chill the dough for at least 3 hours.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C) and line baking sheets with parchment or silicone mats.
Stir the topping sugar and cinnamon together in a bowl.
Roll heaping tablespoons (25g) of dough into balls, coat generously in cinnamon sugar, and space 3 inches apart.
Bake 11–12 minutes until the edges are set and barely browned while the centers still look soft.
Cool 10 minutes on the sheets, then move to a rack to cool completely.
